title: Why Is the Sky Blue?
speaker: NASA Space Place
zh: 【NASA Space Place】天空為什麼是藍色的？（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Why Is the Sky Blue?
cues.en: Why Is the Sky Blue?
cues.zh: 天空為什麼是藍色的？

cues.text: In the middle of a bright, sunny day, the sky is usually a shade of blue.
cues.en: In the middle of a bright, sunny day, the sky is usually a shade of blue.
cues.zh: 在陽光燦爛的日子裡，天空通常是藍色的。

cues.text: Why blue—and not purple, green, or orange?
cues.en: Why blue—and not purple, green, or orange?
cues.zh: 為什麼是藍色，而不是紫色、綠色或橙色？

cues.text: Well, it’s all because of how the Sun’s light reaches Earth!
cues.en: Well, it’s all because of how the Sun’s light reaches Earth!
cues.zh: 好吧，這都是因為太陽光到達地球的方式！

cues.text: If you see light from the Sun hitting the ground, it probably looks like plain white
cues.en: If you see light from the Sun hitting the ground, it probably looks like plain white
cues.zh: 如果你看到太陽發出的光照射到地面上，它可能看起來像純白色

cues.text: light.
cues.en: light.
cues.zh: 光。

cues.text: However, that white light is made up of all the colors of the rainbow.
cues.en: However, that white light is made up of all the colors of the rainbow.
cues.zh: 然而，那白光是由彩虹的所有顏色組成的。

cues.text: You can actually separate and see all these colors if you shine sunlight through a specially
cues.en: You can actually separate and see all these colors if you shine sunlight through a specially
cues.zh: 如果你透過特殊的陽光照射，你實際上可以分開並看到所有這些顏色

cues.text: shaped crystal called a prism.
cues.en: shaped crystal called a prism.
cues.zh: 有形狀的晶體稱為稜鏡。

cues.text: Light energy travels in waves.
cues.en: Light energy travels in waves.
cues.zh: 光能以波的形式傳播。

cues.text: And different colors of light are created by different types of waves.
cues.en: And different colors of light are created by different types of waves.
cues.zh: 不同型別的波會產生不同顏色的光。

cues.text: For example, when our eyes recognize the color red, what we’re actually seeing is long,
cues.en: For example, when our eyes recognize the color red, what we’re actually seeing is long,
cues.zh: 例如，當我們的眼睛辨識出紅色時，我們實際上看到的是長的，

cues.text: stretched-out light waves with peaks that are far apart.
cues.en: stretched-out light waves with peaks that are far apart.
cues.zh: 波峰相距較遠的拉長光波。

cues.text: And when our eyes recognize the color blue, we’re really seeing shorter, choppier light
cues.en: And when our eyes recognize the color blue, we’re really seeing shorter, choppier light
cues.zh: 當我們的眼睛辨識出藍色時，我們確實看到了更短、更不穩定的光

cues.text: waves with peaks that are close together.
cues.en: waves with peaks that are close together.
cues.zh: 波峰靠得很近。

cues.text: The different colors of light are all determined by how stretched out the light waves are.
cues.en: The different colors of light are all determined by how stretched out the light waves are.
cues.zh: 光的不同顏色都是由光波的伸展程度決定的。

cues.text: Together, all the colors make up the spectrum of visible light—the light we can see.
cues.en: Together, all the colors make up the spectrum of visible light—the light we can see.
cues.zh: 所有顏色共同構成了可見光的光譜—我們可以看到的光。

cues.text: So, why do we only see blue light when we look up in the sky on a sunny day?
cues.en: So, why do we only see blue light when we look up in the sky on a sunny day?
cues.zh: 那麼，為什麼在晴天仰望天空時我們只能看到藍光呢？

cues.text: The blue color we see comes from sunlight hitting Earth’s atmosphere—a layer of
cues.en: The blue color we see comes from sunlight hitting Earth’s atmosphere—a layer of
cues.zh: 我們看到的藍色來自陽光照射到地球大氣層——一層

cues.text: gases that gives us air to breathe and keeps the planet warm enough to live on.
cues.en: gases that gives us air to breathe and keeps the planet warm enough to live on.
cues.zh: 氣體為我們提供呼吸空氣並使地球保持足夠溫暖以生存。

cues.text: When sunlight reaches Earth’s atmosphere, it is scattered in all directions by the gases
cues.en: When sunlight reaches Earth’s atmosphere, it is scattered in all directions by the gases
cues.zh: 當陽光到達地球大氣層時，它被氣體向各個方向散射

cues.text: in the air.
cues.en: in the air.
cues.zh: 在空氣中。

cues.text: The types of gases in Earth’s atmosphere mostly scatter the shorter, choppier waves
cues.en: The types of gases in Earth’s atmosphere mostly scatter the shorter, choppier waves
cues.zh: 地球大氣中的氣體型別主要散射較短、波動較大的波

cues.text: of blue light.
cues.en: of blue light.
cues.zh: 的藍光。

cues.text: So, when we see a blue sky, we’re really just seeing all of these blue light waves
cues.en: So, when we see a blue sky, we’re really just seeing all of these blue light waves
cues.zh: 所以，當我們看到藍天時，我們實際上只是看到所有這些藍色光波

cues.text: scattering in our atmosphere.
cues.en: scattering in our atmosphere.
cues.zh: 散射在我們的大氣中。

cues.text: But wait a minute: why is the sky a different color at sunset?
cues.en: But wait a minute: why is the sky a different color at sunset?
cues.zh: 但等一下：為什麼日落時天空的顏色不同？

cues.text: Well, as the Sun gets lower in the sky, its light is passing through more of the atmosphere
cues.en: Well, as the Sun gets lower in the sky, its light is passing through more of the atmosphere
cues.zh: 好吧，隨著太陽在天空中越來越低，它的光會穿過更多的大氣層

cues.text: to reach you.
cues.en: to reach you.
cues.zh: 來聯絡你。

cues.text: So, even more of the blue light is scattered away before it gets to you.
cues.en: So, even more of the blue light is scattered away before it gets to you.
cues.zh: 因此，更多的藍光在到達您之前就被散射掉了。

cues.text: This allows more of the orange and yellow light to pass straight through the atmosphere
cues.en: This allows more of the orange and yellow light to pass straight through the atmosphere
cues.zh: 這使得更多的橙色和黃光可以直接穿過大氣層

cues.text: and directly to your eyes.
cues.en: and directly to your eyes.
cues.zh: 並直接到達您的眼睛。

cues.text: However if the whole sky is glowing red, it could be due to particles of dust, pollution,
cues.en: However if the whole sky is glowing red, it could be due to particles of dust, pollution,
cues.zh: 然而，如果整個天空呈現紅色，可能是由於灰塵顆粒、汙染、

cues.text: or smoke in the air.
cues.en: or smoke in the air.
cues.zh: 或空氣中冒煙。

cues.text: These particles also scatter lots of blue light, which can lead to a very red sky.
cues.en: These particles also scatter lots of blue light, which can lead to a very red sky.
cues.zh: 這些粒子也會散射大量藍光，導致天空呈現非常紅色的效果。

cues.text: NASA’s Earth-observing satellites monitor how many of these particles—called aerosols—are
cues.en: NASA’s Earth-observing satellites monitor how many of these particles—called aerosols—are
cues.zh: 美國太空總署的地球觀測衛星監測這些顆粒（稱為氣溶膠）的數量

cues.text: in our air.
cues.en: in our air.
cues.zh: 在我們的空氣中。

cues.text: The information from these satellites help forecasters keep an eye on particles in the
cues.en: The information from these satellites help forecasters keep an eye on particles in the
cues.zh: 來自這些衛星的資訊幫助預報員密切關注大氣中的顆粒物

cues.text: air and make sure the air is safe to breathe.
cues.en: air and make sure the air is safe to breathe.
cues.zh: 空氣並確保空氣可以安全呼吸。

cues.text: In general, a blue sky is good news.
cues.en: In general, a blue sky is good news.
cues.zh: 一般來說，藍天是個好訊息。

cues.text: And now you know why!
cues.en: And now you know why!
cues.zh: 現在你知道為什麼了！

cues.text: Find out more about our home planet at NASA Space Place.
cues.en: Find out more about our home planet at NASA Space Place.
cues.zh: 在 NASA Space Place 瞭解更多關於我們的家園星球的資訊。
